offering_description.value: Operates regional casinos for local gamblers and leisure travelers. It offers hotel stays, dining and entertainment at select properties and provides sports betting operators with access to select state markets through agreements.

primary_services.value: Casino gaming; hotel lodging; food and beverage service; live entertainment; sports betting market access

customer_segment.value: B2C: Casino patrons, leisure travelers and resort guests; B2B: Sportsbook operators seeking access to regulated state markets

end_markets.value: Casino gaming; hospitality and leisure travel; sports betting

revenue_model.value: other: Wagers on slot machines and table games; service fees: Hotel stays, dining and other resort amenities; licensing or royalties: Contractual market access payments from sportsbook operators
revenue_model.category: other; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Runs casino and resort properties, using gaming equipment and hospitality facilities to serve guests; service provider: Uses state gaming authorizations to provide market access to sportsbook operators

geography_served.value: US regional: Illinois, Indiana, Mississippi, Colorado and Nevada

specialization.value: related lines: Casino gaming, resort lodging, dining, entertainment and sports betting market access

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated casinos and resort properties; online: Company and property websites for hotel reservations; partners / resellers: Third-party sportsbook operators serving bettors through market access agreements

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State gaming boards and commissions license casino operations and sports wagering

notes: The current roster of active sportsbook market access agreements is uncertain.
